scientific_integrity: Complete exact-rational computation checks all 1770 placements through 23 exhaustively verified automorphism orbits; analytic invariant-subspace proof establishes eventual capture. Literature and prior claims were compared at the statement/implication level; priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Exactly the unweighted, 60-vertex truncated-icosahedral adjacency graph with homogeneous Hermitian hopping J>0 and two distinct positive-rate imaginary site absorbers.
Asymptotic one-excitation loss only; finite-time collection, disordered bond strengths, decoherence, interactions, and thermodynamic-limit systems are outside scope.
The classification is finite and exact, but independently confirmed scientific and historical priority are not asserted.
title: Complete two-absorber capture classification on the \(C_{60}\) graph
